nodes.description: Public mapping(address => uint) balanceOf tracking token balances; mutated with unchecked arithmetic inside transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping allowance[owner][spender] used by transferFrom to spend on behalf of _from; decremented without SafeMath.
Private owner address set in constructor to msg.sender; gate for delegate, _mints, init, batchSend, setTradeAddress and the ensure() whitelist.
Private mapping(address => bool) canSale; addresses flagged here bypass the sale condition checks in ensure().
Private mapping(address => uint256) _onSaleNum counting sales per address, compared against _saleNum in condition() and incremented in transferFrom.
Private uint256 _minSale minimal transfer value accepted by condition(), set by init().
Private uint256 _maxSale maximal transfer value accepted by condition(), set by init().
Private uint256 _saleNum maximum number of sales per address, set by init() and enforced in condition().
Address tradeAddress whitelisted inside ensure(); settable only by owner via setTradeAddress.
Public uint totalSupply set in the constructor from _supply and emitted in the initial Transfer event.
Constant public uint decimals = 18 used to scale supply, sale limits and mint amounts.
transfer(address _to, uint _value) payable; forwards msg.sender as _from straight into transferFrom, making it payable and inheriting all of transferFrom's checks.
transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint _value) payable; spends allowance, calls ensure(), and mutates balanceOf/_onSaleNum with unchecked subtraction and addition.
approve(address _spender, uint _value) payable; writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] with no zero-address or race protection.
Internal view ensure(address _from, address _to, uint _value) implementing the whitelist bypass (owner, UNI, computed pair, tradeAddress, canSale) before condition() is required.
Internal view condition(address _from, uint _value) enforcing _saleNum/_onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale sale limits.
delegate(address a, bytes memory b) restricted to owner, performing a.delegatecall(b) with arbitrary target and calldata.
_mints(address spender, uint256 addedValue) minting arbitrary balances and whitelisting the spender for owner or one hardcoded address.
init(uint256 saleNum, uint256 token, uint256 maxToken) owner-only function configuring _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
batchSend(address[] memory _tos, uint _value) owner-only; computes total with unchecked multiplication and subtracts it from balanceOf without SafeMath.
setTradeAddress(address addr) owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Internal pure pairFor(factory, tokenA, tokenB) deriving the Uniswap pair address via keccak256 and a hardcoded init code hash.
Constructor setting name, symbol, totalSupply, owner = msg.sender, minting the full supply and granting unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router UNI.
msg.sender, the externally controlled caller, used for allowance spending, owner checks, whitelisting and mint authorization.
a.delegatecall(b) inside delegate(): executes arbitrary external bytecode in the storage context of this contract.
Unchecked 'allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value' and 'balanceOf[_from] -= _value' in transferFrom, guarded only by manual requires.
Unchecked 'uint total = _value * _tos.length' and 'balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total' in batchSend, allowing overflow for large arrays/values.
Whitelist short-circuit in ensure() that skips condition() entirely for owner, UNI, the computed pair, tradeAddress and any canSale[_from] address.
Parameter _from of transferFrom/ensure identifying the debited account.
Parameter _to of transferFrom identifying the credited recipient.
Parameter _value of transferFrom used for allowance, balance and sale-limit checks.
Local _UNI in ensure() holding the pairFor-derived pool address compared against _from in the whitelist.
Parameter a of delegate(): arbitrary target contract for the low-level delegatecall.
Parameter b of delegate(): arbitrary calldata forwarded to the delegatecall target.
Parameter _tos of batchSend, the array of recipient addresses.
Parameter _value of batchSend, per-recipient amount multiplied unchecked by _tos.length.
Local total in batchSend = _value * _tos.length computed without SafeMath.
Local _to inside the batchSend loop, each credited with _value.
Loop counter i of the batchSend for-loop.
Parameter saleNum of init() assigned to the _saleNum state limit.
Parameter token of init() scaled into _minSale.
Parameter maxToken of init() scaled into _maxSale.
Parameter spender of _mints receiving an arbitrary minted balance and canSale access.
Parameter addedValue of _mints specifying the raw balance written to balanceOf[spender].
Parameter addr of setTradeAddress written into the tradeAddress whitelist slot.

edges.reason: transfer uses msg.sender as the source of the underlying transferFrom call.
transferFrom compares msg.sender with _from and consumes allowance[_from][msg.sender].
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] using the caller-controlled sender.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before the arbitrary delegatecall.
_mints authorizes msg.sender against owner or a hardcoded address.
init requires msg.sender == owner before rewriting sale limits.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before mass balance updates.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner before whitelisting an address.
Constructor sets owner = msg.sender and mints the entire supply to the caller.
owner state variable guards the delegate() entry point.
owner state variable guards the _mints() entry point.
owner state variable guards the init() entry point.
owner state variable guards the batchSend() entry point.
owner state variable guards the setTradeAddress() entry point.
ensure() returns true for any transfer involving owner, bypassing condition().
allowance[_from][msg.sender] is read and decremented inside transferFrom.
balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] are checked and mutated in transferFrom.
canSale[_from] short-circuits ensure() to true, bypassing sale restrictions.
_onSaleNum[_from] is incremented on every transferFrom to count sales.
condition() compares _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum to gate transfers.
_minSale lower bound is enforced against _value in condition().
_maxSale upper bound is enforced against _value in condition().
_saleNum caps the number of sales per address in condition().
tradeAddress is whitelisted inside ensure(), bypassing condition().
decimals scales the raw minted balance in _mints().
decimals scales _minSale and _maxSale in init().
Constructor writes totalSupply and the initial Transfer event amount.
transfer delegates every call to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom must satisfy ensure(_from, _to, _value) before mutating balances.
ensure() calls condition() for any address not in the whitelist.
ensure() derives the comparison pool address through pairFor().
transferFrom performs unchecked subtraction on allowance and balanceOf.
batchSend performs unchecked multiplication and subtraction on balances.
owner-controlled delegate() forwards arbitrary target and calldata into delegatecall.
ensure() short-circuits the sale checks for whitelisted or canSale addresses.
delegatecall executes attacker-influenced external code within this contract's storage context.
_from parameter feeds the allowance and balance checks in transferFrom.
_to parameter receives the credited balance in transferFrom.
_value parameter controls allowance consumption and balance mutation in transferFrom.
Local _UNI is compared against _from inside ensure().
Parameter a is the delegatecall target address in delegate().
Parameter b is the delegatecall payload in delegate().
Parameter _tos supplies the recipient array in batchSend.
Parameter _value is the per-recipient amount in batchSend.
Local total multiplies _value by _tos.length without SafeMath.
Local _to receives _value inside the batchSend loop.
Loop index i drives the batchSend distribution loop.
saleNum parameter is stored into the _saleNum state limit by init().
token parameter is scaled into _minSale by init().
maxToken parameter is scaled into _maxSale by init().
spender parameter receives the minted balance and canSale flag in _mints.
addedValue parameter is multiplied by 10**decimals and written as the raw balance.
addr parameter is stored into the tradeAddress whitelist slot.

normalization_plan.reason: _from is a formal parameter of transferFrom; its dataflow is fully captured by transferFrom's allowance and balance handling.
_to is only used as the credited account inside transferFrom.
_value is the transfer amount checked and subtracted inside transferFrom.
_UNI is a temporary pair address computed and compared only within ensure().
Parameter a is the delegatecall target consumed exclusively by delegate().
Parameter b is the delegatecall calldata consumed exclusively by delegate().
_tos is the recipient array iterated only inside batchSend.
_value is the per-recipient amount used only inside batchSend.
total is the unchecked multiplication result that is subtracted from the sender balance.
_to is the loop-scoped recipient credited inside batchSend.
i is the loop counter that only drives the batchSend distribution loop.
saleNum is assigned to _saleNum only within init().
token is scaled into _minSale only within init().
maxToken is scaled into _maxSale only within init().
spender is the mint recipient and whitelist target inside _mints.
addedValue is multiplied by 10**decimals and written directly to balanceOf without SafeMath, matching the unchecked balance-writing class of unsafe operation.
addr is written into tradeAddress only by setTradeAddress.
